const row = $json ?? {};
const planText = String(row.plan_json ?? '').trim();
if (!planText) throw new Error('Persisted initial task state contains no plan_json.');
const plan = JSON.parse(planText);
return [{json:{
  ...row,
  plan_summary:String(plan.summary ?? ''),
  tasks:Array.isArray(plan.tasks) ? plan.tasks : [],
  task_index:Number(row.task_index ?? 0),
  task_attempt:Number(row.task_attempt ?? 1),
  total_tasks:Array.isArray(plan.tasks) ? plan.tasks.length : 0,
  review_feedback:String(row.review_feedback ?? ''),
  last_review_score:Number(row.last_review_score ?? 0),
  last_review_reason:String(row.last_review_reason ?? ''),
  reviewer_run_id:String(row.reviewer_run_id ?? ''),
  reviewer_status:String(row.reviewer_status ?? ''),
  reviewer_session_id:String(row.reviewer_session_id ?? ''),
  worker_run_id:String(row.worker_run_id ?? ''),
  worker_status:String(row.worker_status ?? ''),
  worker_session_id:String(row.worker_session_id ?? ''),
  architect_run_id:String(row.architect_run_id ?? ''),
  architect_status:String(row.architect_status ?? ''),
  architect_session_id:String(row.architect_session_id ?? ''),
  execution_route:Number(row.task_index ?? 0) >= (Array.isArray(plan.tasks) ? plan.tasks.length : 0) ? 'all_tasks_completed' : 'run_task'
}}];
